lines.en: I crawl across the Burning Plains.
Hot wind sweeps along the ground.

lines.zh: 燃烧平原的灰，落满我的背甲。
lines.en: Burning Plains ash covers my shell.
I skirt a smoking pit.
Every step carries a burnt smell.
I leave tracks in the ash.
I crawl slowly, but I don't rest.
The grass here is all withered.

lines.zh: 我贴着滚烫的地面爬行。
lines.en: I crawl pressed to the scalding ground.
I step across a fissure.
Dust covers my back.
I move through the heat haze.
I head for the shade.
I stop and shake off the ash.
Only fire and stone here.
I move segment by segment.
I lie still on the stone.
Pressed to the ground, I crawl along.
I tuck my legs in.
There's no night on the Burning Plains.
I'm waiting for something to wander by.
My mouthparts work slowly.
Ash settles in my shell's seams.
The ground here burns the feet.
I creep low across the burning plains.
There's a scorched smell in the wind.
I sink into the ash and hide.
Waiting quietly.
So you came here too.
This place doesn't suit you.

lines.zh: 燃烧平原的地面，烫得很。
lines.en: The burning plains scorch the ground.

lines.zh: 焦土上，你身上的汗味很清楚。
lines.en: On the scorched ground, your sweat is easy to smell.
Don't stand so close.
I claimed this stone first.
Your shadow is cool, at least.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的鞋，找落脚的空隙。
lines.en: I watch your boots, hunting for a gap to strike.
I know each step you take.
There's no cover in this ash field.
Sparks flew onto my shell.

lines.zh: 背壳裂开，热灰钻进缝里。
lines.en: My back shell splits; hot ash gets in.
I slid half a step in the ash.
Fighting here makes it hotter.

lines.zh: 我把头和腿全收进壳里。
lines.en: I pull my head and legs into my shell.

lines.zh: 腿伤了，我用腹甲蹭着走。
lines.en: My leg is hurt; I drag myself on my belly plate.
Your club hit the shell.

lines.zh: 火山灰糊住伤口，又烫又痒。
lines.en: Volcanic ash packs the wound, hot and itching.
I shift away toward the hot pit.

lines.zh: 壳上多一道白痕，我记着。
lines.en: A white mark on my shell. I'll remember.
That smell isn't ash.
There's a different smell here.
I don't know if that's edible.
Low, down to the ash.
Hungry as I am, I do not charge into fire.
Water in your hand? Set it on the ground first.

lines.zh: 这味道是从你手上来的。
lines.en: The smell comes from your hand.

lines.zh: 我不常遇见带东西的人。
lines.en: I don't often meet someone carrying things.
You take a bite first.
I'll just look.
You stepped on me in the ash.
My shell scraped off a layer of ash.

lines.zh: 壳沿硌脚，你踩上来会疼。
lines.en: My shell rim is sharp; stepping on me will hurt.

lines.zh: 被碰了一下，我缩回壳里。
lines.en: Touched once, I pull back into my shell.
The stones here are too slippery.

lines.zh: 壳沿撞上你的脚，我挪开。
lines.en: My shell rim hits your foot; I shift aside.
Your boot touched my legs.
I sprang back a little.
We're jammed in one crack.
The burning plains soil is still hot.
Too few living things here.
I rarely even see my own kind.
Hard to say such things in the ash.
Go away.
The heat drains me of everything.
Wait until this land cools.
I haven't found water yet.
Eggs in the shell take a long time.
I keep crawling.
Pretend I didn't hear.
This stone is rather bright.

lines.zh: 黏沼泽的牙，试着咬一口。
lines.en: Sticky-marsh teeth try a bite.
This black stone—my jaws can't dent it.
You dropped it. I'm taking it.
So hard. What use is it?
I push it into a crack.
It's baked hot.
I don't really need it.
Leave it. Don't burn yourself.
I'll hide it first.
A shape in the heat haze.
Not the wind.

lines.zh: 我从壳下伸出头，朝你仰起。
lines.en: I poke my head from under the shell and raise it at you.
The scent is warm.
I turn that way slowly.
The ash field hides nothing.

lines.zh: 你也看见我了，那就别跑。
lines.en: You've seen me. So don't run.
Then never mind.
I'll go anyway.

lines.zh: 焦原上没有掩体，只能冲。
lines.en: No cover on the scorched plain. Only the charge.
I lift my belly off the ground.
Ash hides half of it.

lines.zh: 热浪里我立起前肢，不让路。
lines.en: In the heat I raise my forelegs and hold my ground.

lines.zh: 燃烧平原上，我这层甲就够用。
lines.en: On the burning plains this shell is enough.

lines.zh: 我压低壳，从石缝间穿过。
lines.en: Shell low, I slip between the cracks in the rock.

lines.zh: 你站在那儿不动，我绕着圈。
lines.en: You stand still, and I circle.

lines.zh: 我的壳在灰里很难看清。
lines.en: My shell is hard to see in the ash.
I creep half a block closer.
I stop moving.
The wind blows ash over me.
Now I'm even harder to spot.
You turn to look; I don't hide.
I circle left.
There's a hot pit ahead.
I need to go around.
It's about to leave.
I bury myself in the ash.

lines.zh: 只剩三步，我的颚已经张开。
lines.en: Three steps left and my mandibles are open.
I burst out of the ash.
I caught it.

lines.zh: 我的口器不大，但咬得紧。
lines.en: My mouthparts are small but they grip.
It tore free of my grip.
I bite down somewhere else.
I put strength into that one.
It backed behind the stone.
On the burning plains, fire does not scare me.
The heat here drains me.
It's about to get away.
I come out of the ash heap.
Heat slaps me in the face.
This ground is fiercely hot.

lines.zh: 我抖落背甲上的火山灰。
lines.en: I shake the volcanic ash off my shell.
Few living people on the Burning Plains.
Yet there you stand.

lines.zh: 燃烧平原的火，我爬得过去。
lines.en: I can crawl through the burning plains' fire.
The wind here never stops burning.

lines.zh: 我从灰堆里钻出，壳还烫着。
lines.en: I crawl out of the ash pile, shell still hot.
Sparks still lie on the ground.

lines.zh: 这片地本来就烧，火反而习惯了。
lines.en: This land already burns. Fire is familiar.

lines.zh: 从石头上翻下来，我滚了半圈。
lines.en: I tumbled off the stone half a turn.

lines.zh: 这里的水是烫的，我赶紧爬出来。
lines.en: The water here is boiling. I scrambled out.

lines.zh: 炸起的碎石砸在我的壳上。
lines.en: Blown stone struck my shell.

lines.zh: 箭卡在壳缝里，我甩不掉。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in my shell seam and won't shake loose.

lines.zh: 一道光扫过来，我眼前发白。
lines.en: A flash swept over me and my sight went white.
Ash doesn't fill me.

lines.zh: 雷声在平原上滚过，我伏低。
lines.en: Thunder rolled across the plains. I flattened down.
It's sickeningly empty underfoot.
